spec.model: none; generated complete GDN WU, recurrent state and output components with the original SM121 exponential table
spec.purpose: Isolated preparation of two original table-derived FP32 values per token/head: exp(g) and exp(g_last_valid_in_chunk-g). WU, state and output share these views instead of repeating the same table lookups. Exact transformed-source audit confirms their kernel bodies change only exponential reads and the table argument. Preserve all scalar K16 matrix arithmetic, BF16 checkpoints/residuals, final FMAs, U=V ownership and causal tail endpoints. Every intermediate, final output/state, prepared value, input and guard is checked against actual originals and independent CPU references. Safety includes six lengths through1024 and four zero/finite/subnormal/special-gate families with both U ownership modes. q8192 uses one warmup and three rotated complete-owner measurements including gate preparation. Same-stream stage events resolve after final completion; no intermediate host synchronization. Generated full-length recurrence differs from production1024-row partitioning; no model, token, inference, retained performance or release acceptance.

prior_failure.reason: Invalid GPU phase duration aborted the observer before complete comparison. New harness records invalid device intervals and their raw bits, excludes their median, and continues all numerical checks; complete host timings remain authoritative. No kernel arithmetic change.

implementation: Prepare exp(g) and exp(g_last_valid_in_chunk-g) once per token/head with the original SM121 table. WU, scalar state8 and output share those FP32 views. Original ordered scalar K16 dots, BF16 tap/endpoint rounding, FP32 state/FMA order, shared layouts, complete U=V ownership and final causal chunk endpoints remain unchanged. Additional scratch is two token-by32 float arrays; production dispatch is unchanged.
correctness_scope: 96 native comparisons cover six lengths from1 through1024, zero/finite/subnormal inputs and a special gate family, original/prepared kernels and separate/aliased U. Seven invalid preparation calls reject zero/oversized extents, short storage, overlapping or misaligned storage and missing tables. Every prepared word matches an independent CPU lookup. Every output, final state, W/U, state checkpoint and residual matches the actual original kernels. CPU columns independently verify WU and full recurrence for zero/finite families. All attempts, source/table immutability, unused U and guards pass. q8192 uses generated data and a complete8192-row state call, distinct from production1024-row segments; no model or new GB10 token boundary is measured.
timing_scope: One warmup and three rotated same-executable completed host samples for each variant and U ownership mode include gate preparation, WU, state and output. Allocation/reset/upload/observation are outside the owner clock. Five same-stream events provide four diagnostic phase intervals and resolve only after final completion. The first observer aborted on an invalid interval; the corrected observer preserves its raw bits and excludes invalid phase medians while completing numerical checks. All complete host samples remain separate from these phase diagnostics. Safety timing zeros are placeholders.

decision.disposition: Keep shared gate views isolated; do not change GDN provider or product stack.
decision.reason: The U=V complete q8192 component median decreases6.1351 ms, while separate U increases4.9879 ms and host samples overlap. This modest, ownership-dependent observation does not establish a seconds-scale model improvement. No real model capture or token gate was run for this route.
decision.next_focus: Return to common matrix correction and projection ownership, which account for larger measured product walls.
